HE IS DEAD WHO CALLED ME INTO BEING; AND WHEN I SHALL BE NO MORE, THE VERY REMEMBRANCE OF US BOTH WILL SPEEDILY VANISH. I SHALL NO LONGER SEE THE SUN OR STARS OR FEEL THE WINDS PLAY ON MY CHEEKS.
